about: A terminal file manager that works like a command shell.

prs.title: Bulk rename no longer gives files the wrong names
prs.broken: When one listed file was missing, bulk rename gave every file after it the next file's new name, and one file was not renamed.
prs.changed: Bulk rename now pairs new names only with the files it actually listed.
prs.matters: Renaming many files at once can't silently mix up their names.
